note: 16 elements carry no data-weft-id; their ids are generated
what is shown depends on coupon, which is not a data path; every branch is kept
<Price> is a component, not an element Weft knows; only its children are kept
style opacity: 1; padding: 8px is left out
{`Total: ${total}`} is not a data path or markup Weft can read; it is left out
the text written beside the bound value is left out
value={coupon} is not a literal or a data path; it is left out
onChange={(e) => setCoupon(e.target.value)} calls no action Weft can read; it is left out
